items.title: Zyphra ZYFA: FP8 FlashAttention for AMD MI355X, Up to 1.76x Faster
items.body:
Zyphra released ZYFA, open-source FP8 and BF16 prefill attention kernels for AMD Instinct MI355X. On real model activations, its FP8 kernels run 1.16-1.76x faster than AMD’s AITER, with 62-78% lower error at head dimension 128.

The post Zyphra ZYFA: FP8 FlashAttention for AMD MI355X, Up to 1.76x Faster appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: [AINews] We have moved!! Please help us move!
items.body:
Hi Friends,

For a little over a year, AINews has been functioning in MVP mode on Buttondown, which is an excellent email service by Justin Duke. We went far, far longer on it than we ever thought possible, including having our crappy signup page featured on Lex Fridman thanks to a @levelsio shoutout!

However, we wanted to improve our signup, deliverability, and web experience, and so have now moved to a custom Resend + Vercel + SmolTalk (coming soon™) stack. We'll be talking more about it at the next AI Engineer conference in SF in June.

anyway, please mosey on over to https://news.smol.ai/ where you'll immediately see the win of fast, faceted search!

and look out for emails from "news@smol.ai" going forward - we have less email authority on that one so if you can pick us out of spam hell and drop us in the blessed IMPORTANT folder we'd be very grateful.

More updates are coming! We are almost done paying down tech debt.

—- your friends at smol.ai
